visual_target.visual_comparison_method: checklist against the figure legend / textual target (axes, variables, group order, scale, legend) — no pixel or image-similarity comparison

known_missing_information: The paper models body mass with linear models including sex and covariates; this panel shows a standard nonparametric pairwise comparison on the same data (documented in differences).
